bio.text: Christine Cohen has represented Connecticut's 12th Senate District since 2019 and is the Democratic candidate for the seat on the November 3, 2026 ballot.
She graduated from Western Connecticut State University in 1998 with a B.B.A. in marketing and from the University of Connecticut School of Business in 2004 with an M.B.A.
She became owner of Cohen's Bagel Company in 2003 and previously worked as an inventory analyst, an account manager and a sales planner.
